extDescription.message: Shows the travel direction of long-distance trains during seat booking on bahn.de

directionChanges.message: The travel direction changes during the journey as follows:

noValidityHint.message: No wagon order available for this date.

disclaimer.message: *Wagon orders may change on the day of travel.

donateAppeal.message: This is a hobby project – I’d appreciate a small donation!

obWelcomeSub.message: Never ride backwards again: this extension shows you the direction of travel of your ICE, IC or EC during seat selection on bahn.de.

obStep1.message: Search for a connection with ICE, IC or EC on bahn.de as usual.

obStep2.message: Open “Select seat” for your connection — the coach layout appears there.

obStep3.message: Click the Train Direction icon in the toolbar.

obMockInfo.message: The arrow shows the direction of travel in the coach layout

obReadySub.message: You’re all set for your next ticket purchase — the extension stays quiet on its own and collects no data.

obPinTip.message: Tip: click the puzzle icon 🧩 next to the address bar and pin Train Direction so the icon is always visible.
